feeds.title: New England Folklore
feeds.description: I am an Avid folklore fan and a new England native. Author of witches and warlocks of Massachusetts and legends and lore of the north shore (2014). My work has appeared in various other places, including magical folk: British and Irish Fairies: ad 500 to present (2018), and Sam Baltrusis's 13 most haunted crime scenes beyond Boston (2016).

feeds.title: Icy Sedgwick » Folklore
feeds.description: I'm Icy - a folklore blogger and host of the Fabulous Folklore podcast. I also write fiction - dark fantasy, supernatural mysteries, Gothic horror, and Westerns.

feeds.title: Dead But Dreaming
feeds.description: A place where the faeries of folklore meet the faeries of reality. This is a blog site about the otherworldly creatures most often known as faeries. They have taken many forms over the centuries, and interact with humanity in a myriad of ways.

feeds.title: The American Folklore Society
feeds.description: The American Folklore Society is a membership organization dedicated to supporting the individuals and organizations engaged in the study and advancement of folklore and expressive cultural traditions throughout the world.

feeds.title: New York Folklore
feeds.description: Read the latest news from New York Folklore and enjoy guest posts by folklorists in the field. Learn more about the diverse folk arts of our state! New York Folklore is New York State's only statewide organization that supports and amplifies traditional arts and culture in New York.

feeds.title: Seven Miles of Steel Thistles
feeds.description: Katherine writes children's and YA fantasy. Her books have been sold worldwide and have been translated into many languages. For adults, she writes semi-academic non-fiction on folklore, fairy tales, and fantasy.

feeds.title: Angus Folklore
feeds.description: A trawl through the folklore, history, tales, and ephemera of Angus.

feeds.title: Folklore Thursday
feeds.description: Putting the folk back into folklore since 2015!

feeds.title: Fairytalez.com Blog
feeds.description: At Fairytalez, we love fairytales and folklore. Read insightful and inspiring articles about fairy tales, folk tales, and folklore at Fairytalez.

feeds.title: Folklore Fellows
feeds.description: Folklore Fellows is an international network of folklorists, promoting scientific contacts between researchers, publication work, and research training.

feeds.title: VAMzzz Occult Blog » Folklore
feeds.description: This section features articles on folklore. VAMzzz Publishing creates new and revised editions of books in the categories Magic & Witchcraft, Secret Rites & Societies, Demonology, Celtic & Mythology and Astrology. These books are written by either highly qualified academic researchers, or experts in a special field of esoteric knowledge, craft or practice.

feeds.title: Alys West Blog
feeds.description: Alys West is the writer of folklore inspired fantasy. Here you'll find information about my books, my 'book whispering' services, my blog, and the mindful writing sessions I run online.

feeds.title: Folklore and Fern
feeds.description: Enter into the mists of history, archetypes, plant wisdom, and folklore. Follow the path down into the Sacred Wood and discover your deepest intuitions and inherent healing abilities. Folklore and Fern is an earthy, witchy, mythic place for healing and exploration.

feeds.title: The Faery Folklorist
feeds.description: A Faery Folklore enthusiast living in the deepest depths of Northumberland, seeking the truth behind fairy stories, and tracking down the places at the heart of them.
